blocks.prompt: 2. Find the \(n^{\text{th}}\) term of the arithmetic-geometric sequence, where the arithmetic part is \(3, 7, 11, \ldots\) and the geometric part is \(2, 6, 18, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Question 1 jaisa hi hai, farq sirf itna hai ke ab koi khaas term (jaise 8th) nahi, balki general \(n\)th term chahiye, yani aisa formula jis mein \(n\) rakh kar koi bhi term mil jaye.
Plan: A.P. ka \(n\)th term aur G.P. ka \(n\)th term \(n\) ki shakal mein likho, phir dono ko multiply karo aur saaf likho.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: A.P. part \(3, 7, 11, \ldots\) (\(a = 3, d = 4\)); G.P. part \(2, 6, 18, \ldots\) (\(b = 2, r = 3\))
Humein find karna hai: \(n\)th term \(T_n\).
Tareeqa: A.G.P. ka \(n\)th term = (A.P. part ka \(n\)th term) \(\times\) (G.P. part ka \(n\)th term), yani \(T_n = [a + (n - 1)d]\,br^{n-1}\). A.P. ka term \(a + (n - 1)d\) aur G.P. ka term \(br^{n-1}\) alag alag nikalte hain, phir dono ko multiply kar dete hain.

A.P. part ka \(n\)th term
\[a_n = 3 + (n - 1)(4)\]
\[= 3 + 4n - 4\]
\[= 4n - 1\]
Kyun: \(d = 7 - 3 = 4\). Formula \(a + (n - 1)d\) mein values rakhi, bracket khola: \(4(n - 1) = 4n - 4\), phir \(3 - 4 = -1\). Choti si tasdeeq: \(n = 2\) par \(4(2) - 1 = 7\), jo A.P. ka doosra term hai.

G.P. part ka \(n\)th term
\[b_n = 2 \cdot 3^{n-1}\]
Kyun: \(r = 6 \div 2 = 3\). G.P. ka formula \(br^{n-1}\) hai. Isay aur simplify nahi karna: \(2 \cdot 3^{n-1}\) ko \(6^{n-1}\) likhna bilkul ghalat hai, kyunke power sirf 3 par lagi hai, 2 par nahi.

Multiply karein
\[T_n = (4n - 1) \cdot 2 \cdot 3^{n-1}\]
\[= 2(4n - 1)\,3^{n-1}\]
Kyun: A.G.P. ka term dono ka product hai. Number 2 ko saamne likh dene se jawab saaf aur book ke andaaz jaisa ho jata hai.

\(n = 1\) aur \(n = 2\) se tasdeeq
\[T_1 = 2(3)(3^{0}) = 6 = 3 \times 2\]
\[T_2 = 2(7)(3) = 42 = 7 \times 6\]
Kyun: Pehla A.G.P. term \(3 \times 2 = 6\) aur doosra \(7 \times 6 = 42\) hona chahiye. Formula bhi yehi deta hai, is liye jawab sahi hai.
